definitions.explanation: Text displayed on screen showing dialogue or narration in films and videos.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}の{字幕|じまく}をつけて{見|み}る。
{字幕|じまく}{版|ばん}と{吹|ふ}き{替|か}え{版|ばん}がある。
examples.english: There's a subtitled version and a dubbed version.

examples.japanese: {字幕|じまく}を{読|よ}むのが{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: It's hard to read the subtitles.

notes:
COMPOUND: {字|じ} (character) + {幕|まく} (curtain, screen)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{字幕|じまく}をつける (to add subtitles)
・{字幕|じまく}を{読|よ}む (to read subtitles)
・{字幕|じまく}{版|ばん} (subtitled version)
・{日本語|にほんご}{字幕|じまく} (Japanese subtitles)
・{英語|えいご}{字幕|じまく} (English subtitles)
・{字幕|じまく}なし (without subtitles)
・クローズドキャプション (closed captions)

CONTRAST:
・{字幕|じまく} - subtitles
・{吹|ふ}き{替|か}え - dubbing

[Register: Neutral]
